interpretation: Structural validity and traceability do not establish completeness or learner readiness. Higher-level sources, alternate paths, and other source outcomes are inspection signals, not automatic defects. Do not delete edges or split decks without evaluating their contracts.

exclusions.subject: mathematics
exclusions.rationale: Scheme theory, automorphic forms, forcing and higher-category methods are specialist extensions; algebraic foundations remain at mathematics/rings-and-fields:ideals-and-factorization, mathematics/commutative-algebra:localization, and mathematics/mathematical-logic:formal-semantics.

exclusions.subject: computer-science
exclusions.rationale: Foundation-model scaling research and specialized accelerator design are outside the representative advanced progression; neural training is taught at computer-science/machine-learning:neural-optimization and parallel execution at computer-science/parallel-computing:parallel-implementation.

exclusions.subject: physics
exclusions.domain: Quantum gravity and specialist field theory
exclusions.rationale: Quantum gravity and precision nonperturbative field-theory research are specialist extensions; classical gravitation is taught at physics/general-relativity:einstein-equations and perturbative fields at physics/quantum-field-theory:perturbative-amplitudes.

exclusions.subject: chemistry
exclusions.domain: Professional chemical engineering and pharmacy qualifications
exclusions.rationale: Industrial plant design and clinical pharmacy are separate professional curricula, not prerequisites for the chemical science taught here.

exclusions.subject: biology
exclusions.rationale: Clinical practice, veterinary licensure and regulated release authorization are separate qualifications. Disease mechanisms remain at biology/pathobiology:injury-and-degeneration and biology/infectious-disease:host-pathogen-mechanisms.
